summary: This bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to allow proprietary institutions of higher education to count non-federal revenue generated from distance education programs towards the "90/10 rule," which limits the amount of federal funding they can receive.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to allow revenue from distance education programs at proprietary institutions to count towards the non-federal revenue requirement (90/10 rule). This change primarily affects the funding structure and financial operations of proprietary higher education institutions, rather than directly increasing or decreasing spending on public schools.
